_comment: Awin shops of Men's Gear World for the shared import and the Hub's shadow catalogue (31 Oct 2026, phase 4 of 'every product through the Hub'). The general rules are in sites/_shared/fashion-rules.js; a shop here can set: genderSections false (its sections do not tell men from women: Cronjager files men's rings under Women's Jewellery), audience 'men' or 'women' (a shop for one of them), defaultCategory (a shop whose names give only the model), sectionHints false or a list of trusted top sections (Joybuy: only its "Health & Beauty" sections are reliable). The older per-shop import rules (tools/import-rules/) still load this site until the shared import replaces them. More shops of the site's database (Stan Ray, Finediam, Stattics, Watch Enclave, WATCH & WATCH, Philip Jones) are added once their Awin ids are checked against the Awin list.
